en.wizard.provider_choice.google_ads.offici: Standard Google API; same OAuth as mureo standard.

en.wizard.providers_install.title: Install official MCP
en.wizard.providers_install.installing: Installing… this can take a minute (a package is built from source).
en.wizard.providers_install.failed: Install failed: {detail}. Check that pipx and network are available, or use mureo standard instead.
en.wizard.providers_install.needs_credentia: Installed, but the official Google Ads MCP can't authenticate yet. It uses Application Default Credentials (ADC): point it at a Google Ads service-account JSON file below. A Developer Token is also required (set during Google Ads authentication). The client_id/secret/refresh_token used by mureo standard are NOT read by the official server. mureo standard stays active until this is set, so you keep working.
Installed, but the official MCP can't authenticate yet — set its required credentials, then retry. mureo standard stays active until then.
en.wizard.providers_install.still_needs_cre: Still missing credentials. Confirm the path is correct and the Developer Token was set during Google Ads authentication.
en.wizard.auth.amazon_ads_desc: Amazon Ads uses Login with Amazon credentials from your Amazon Ads API application. Fill in the client ID plus either an access token or the refresh-token and client-secret pair — mureo mints access tokens from that pair for you. The fields below come from the Amazon Ads integration itself.
en.wizard.auth.meta_oauth_localhost_hint: Live-mode Meta apps cannot complete login from this localhost page — Facebook rejects the localhost redirect. Switch to the system-user token option above instead.
en.wizard.auth.meta_method_chooser_subtitle: Pick one — you do not need both.
en.wizard.auth.meta_method_token_desc: For Live apps and automation. Never expires; no browser login.
en.wizard.auth.meta_method_oauth_desc: For Development-mode apps. Requires browser login and renews about every 60 days.
en.wizard.auth.meta_token_card_intro: Recommended for Live apps and automation. Generate a Business Manager system-user token and paste it here — no browser login required. For tokens issued with the 60-day expiry, mureo tracks the date and can renew them; a token issued without one is left as it is.
en.wizard.auth.meta_token_account_hint: Optional — leave unselected if the ad account is assigned elsewhere; you can set or change it later.
en.wizard.auth.meta_token_invalid: Meta rejected this access token — it has expired, been revoked, or was issued for a different app. Generate a new system-user token in Business settings and paste it here.
en.wizard.auth.meta_token_account_fetch_fai: The token is valid, but Meta did not return your ad accounts. Nothing was saved — wait a moment and try again.
en.wizard.auth.meta_token_guide_1: Business settings → System users → create a system user with the Admin role.
en.wizard.auth.meta_token_guide_2: Assign the ad account (Manage ads) and the Page (Manage content) to that system user.
en.wizard.auth.meta_token_guide_3: Generate a token for your Live app — pick the 60-day expiry if you want mureo to track and renew it — with ads_management, ads_read, business_management, pages_manage_ads, pages_read_engagement.
en.wizard.auth.meta_token_guide_4: Copy the generated token and paste it above, then Validate and Save.
en.wizard.auth.meta_token_app_hint: Optional, and the only way mureo can check this token's expiry: Meta lets an app inspect its own tokens, nothing else. Add the app ID and secret of the app that issued the token and mureo reads the date — then renews the token before it expires, if it was issued with the 60-day expiry. A token issued without an expiry is never renewed.
en.wizard.auth.meta_token_expiry_unknown: Meta did not report an expiry for this token, so mureo cannot show a countdown for it.
en.wizard.auth.meta_token_expiry_untracked: Expiry not checked — see the note below.
en.wizard.auth.meta_token_never_expires: This token does not expire. mureo will not renew it.
en.wizard.auth.meta_token_warn_expiry_untra: mureo did not check this token's expiry: inspecting a token needs the app ID and app secret of the app that issued it. Add them above to track the date — or leave them blank if the token was issued without an expiry.
en.wizard.auth.meta_token_warn_inspect_fail: Meta refused to describe this token — the app ID and secret may belong to a different app than the one that issued it. The token was still saved and works; only the expiry date is missing.
en.wizard.auth.meta_token_warn_auto_refresh: This token expires and no app ID / secret is stored, so mureo cannot renew it for you. Add them above, or plan to paste a fresh token before the date shown.
en.wizard.auth.save_failed: Could not save. Check the values and try again.
en.wizard.auth.amazon_saved_now_authorize: Saved. Now authorize with Amazon below — or continue if you already pasted a refresh token.
en.wizard.completed.title: Setup complete
en.wizard.completed.desc: Your mureo configuration has been saved.

en.dashboard.title: mureo configuration
en.dashboard.creative_gallery_hint: Generated visuals and composed banners, grouped per run. Read-only.
en.dashboard.creative_gallery_empty: No generated creatives yet. Run /creative-generate from your agent to see results here.
en.dashboard.reports_hint: KPIs are sourced from STATE.json — switch the window with the toggle above.
en.dashboard.reports_period_adhoc: Not a mureo window. An agent stored figures under this label; mureo reports on Yesterday, Last 7 days and Last 30 days, and only those are kept up to date.
en.dashboard.reports_stats_more: +{n} more fields in the report (open the report to read them)
en.dashboard.reports_sorted_by_status: Sorted by status (needs action → watch → clear)
en.dashboard.reports_roster_total: Total / {n} clients (CPA is a weighted average)
en.dashboard.reports_roster_total_stated: Total / {n} clients ({stated} with figures; CPA is a weighted average)
en.dashboard.reports_roster_total_shown: Total / {n} shown (CPA is a weighted average)
en.dashboard.reports_roster_total_shown_sta: Total / {n} shown ({stated} with figures; CPA is a weighted average)
en.dashboard.reports_tier_changes_note: The metrics that moved most against the day before
en.dashboard.reports_empty_hint: Run sync-state to pull the latest campaign snapshots, then refresh.
en.dashboard.reports_conflict_double_counte: One ad account is stored under two platform keys ({keys}), so its spend, conversions and CPA are counted twice.
en.dashboard.reports_stale_kpis_withheld: These figures were collected before the window shown, so mureo does not state them as its result. What was last collected is below.
en.dashboard.reports_stale_last_collected_u: Last collected at an unknown time: {figures}
en.dashboard.reports_not_collected: {platform} could not be collected {ago}: {reason}. The figures shown are the last ones collected — they are not wrong, they are older.
en.dashboard.reports_not_collected_undated: {platform} could not be collected: {reason}. The figures shown are the last ones collected — they are not wrong, they are older.
en.dashboard.reports_conflict_unknown_key: Unrecognised platform key ({keys}) — mureo cannot tell which advertising platform it names, so it is labelled with the raw key. The ad account it describes is identified, and its figures are unaffected.
en.dashboard.reports_conflict_unknown_key_n: Unrecognised platform key ({keys}) — mureo cannot tell which advertising platform it names, and the entry records no ad account, so it may be a duplicate of another entry that mureo cannot see. Review it by hand; nothing is merged or removed for you.
en.dashboard.reports_conflict_repair_hint: Run `mureo repair platform-key` in a terminal to see what mureo can repair here. It shows what it would change and changes nothing until you confirm.
en.dashboard.reports_conflict_duplicate_rep: Only you can say which of the two entries holds the right figures — mureo will not choose. Once you have, remove the other in a terminal: `mureo repair platform-key --key <the key to remove> --drop-duplicate`. It shows what it would change and changes nothing until you add --apply.
en.dashboard.reports_reorder_hint: Drag to reorder, or focus this handle and use the arrow keys. The order is saved in this browser only.
en.dashboard.reports_archive_confirm: Archive {name}? While it is archived, this client's figures are never collected — the scheduled sync skips it and nothing is recorded for that period. Un-archiving resumes collection from that point; it does not backfill the gap.
en.dashboard.reports_archive_failed: Could not change this client's archived state. Nothing was changed.
en.dashboard.reports_archived_hint: Archived clients are not synced, so no figures are collected while they are archived. Restoring one resumes collection from that point; the gap is not backfilled.
en.dashboard.reports_all_archived: Every client is archived. Un-archive one below to start collecting its figures again.
en.dashboard.reports_triage_double_counted: Client totals cannot be stated — one ad account is stored under two platform keys ({keys}), so any total over them counts it twice.
en.dashboard.reports_triage_stale: Client totals cannot be stated — the newest figures were collected {ago}, before the window shown.
en.dashboard.reports_triage_stale_undated: Client totals cannot be stated — the figures were collected before the window shown, and no collection time is recorded.
en.dashboard.reports_triage_unknown_key: mureo cannot tell which advertising platform {keys} names, so this client's entries cannot be fully checked for a duplicate.
en.dashboard.reports_triage_observation_due: {n} logged changes are past their review date (oldest {date}).
en.dashboard.reports_triage_next_collect: Run /sync-state for this client to collect the window shown.
en.dashboard.reports_triage_next_report: Open this client's report to see what the finding is based on.
en.dashboard.reports_triage_next_not_collec: Clear the cause above, then run /sync-state for this client.
en.dashboard.reports_triage_next_observatio: Run /daily-check for this client — its evidence step evaluates every observation that is due.
en.dashboard.reports_triage_dismiss: Hide this alert for {client} ({what}). It is not resolved by hiding it.
en.dashboard.reports_triage_dismiss_group: Hide all {n} alerts in this row ({what}). They are not resolved by hiding them.
en.dashboard.reports_triage_hidden_note: Hiding an alert does not resolve it. Every condition below is still true, still counted above, and still marks its client's card — and an alert comes back on its own as soon as what it says changes.
en.dashboard.reports_unreachable: mureo could not fetch {n} clients just now. Reloading will try again.
en.dashboard.reports_portfolio_unstated: mureo cannot state this for any client in the window shown
en.dashboard.native_none: No platforms connected via mureo yet.
en.dashboard.native_sc_shared: Search Console uses this Google sign-in (removing Google Ads also removes Search Console access).
en.dashboard.native_sc_row_note: Uses the Google Ads Google sign-in (set up via the wizard). Remove it from the Google Ads row.
en.dashboard.confirm_remove_credentials: Remove these saved credentials from ~/.mureo/credentials.json? You will need to re-authenticate to use this platform again.
en.dashboard.meta_access_token_expiring: This Meta access token is {days} days old. Meta expires long-lived tokens about 60 days after they are issued, and mureo's automatic renewal has not replaced this one — re-authenticate to avoid an interruption.
en.dashboard.meta_token_expires_in: This Meta access token expires on {date} — {days} days left. Renew it before then: add the app ID and secret so mureo can extend it automatically, or generate a new system-user token in Business settings and paste it here.
en.dashboard.meta_token_expired: This Meta access token expired on {date}. Every Meta report will fail until it is replaced — generate a new system-user token in Business settings and paste it here.
en.dashboard.meta_token_never_expires: This Meta access token does not expire.
en.dashboard.advisors_desc: External MCP servers that mureo_consult_advisor queries for second-opinion insights. Each entry lives in ~/.mureo/insight_sources.json.
en.dashboard.advisors_security_note: Security: a stdio advisor runs an arbitrary local command, and any env values you set are passed to that third-party binary. Add only advisors you trust.
en.dashboard.advisors_args_hint: Example — command "npx" with these args: -y / @acme/advisor-mcp. One argument per line (do not include the command itself).
en.dashboard.advisors_env_hint: Example: API_KEY=sk-xxxx — one KEY=VALUE per line. Passed to the command as environment variables (the binary handles its own auth).
en.dashboard.advisors_headers_hint: Example: Authorization=Bearer <token> — one KEY=VALUE per line. Bearer auth for http/sse advisors goes here.
en.dashboard.advisors_err_duplicate_name: An advisor with that name already exists.
en.dashboard.advisors_err_invalid: Check the fields — a required value is missing or invalid.
en.dashboard.plugin_credentials_empty: No installed plugin declares per-account credentials.
en.dashboard.creative_studio_desc: Bring-your-own-key image providers for text-free ad key visuals. Only configured providers are selectable by the agent — set an API key below, or use the local Codex CLI provider (needs no key here, just `codex login`). Leave a field blank to keep its stored key.
en.dashboard.creative_studio_openai_hint: Unlocks gpt-image generation and the art-direction edit path.
en.dashboard.creative_studio_gemini_hint: Unlocks Gemini image / Imagen generation and the edit path.
en.dashboard.creative_studio_fal_hint: Unlocks FLUX / Recraft generation (no edit path).
en.dashboard.amazon_refresh_manifest_hint: Amazon’s tools are read from a manifest generated on this machine. Refresh it after saving credentials, and whenever Amazon changes its tool surface.
en.dashboard.amazon_refresh_manifest_done: Tool list updated ({count} tools). Restart the mureo MCP server to pick them up.
en.dashboard.amazon_refresh_manifest_failed: Could not refresh the tool list. Check the saved credentials and the region, then try again.
en.dashboard.amazon_refresh_manifest_no_cre: Save the Amazon Ads credentials first, then refresh the tool list.
en.dashboard.amazon_authorize_hint: Save the Client ID and Client Secret above first. Then open Amazon’s consent page, approve access, and copy the FULL address you land on from your browser’s address bar (it contains code=…) into the box below. The code is valid for 5 minutes.
en.dashboard.amazon_authorize_opening: Amazon opened in a new tab. After approving, copy the full address you land on and paste it below.
en.dashboard.amazon_authorize_failed: Could not build the Amazon authorization link. Check the saved Client ID and region, then try again.
en.dashboard.amazon_authorize_no_credential: Save the Client ID in this card first, then authorize.
en.dashboard.amazon_exchange_done: Authorized. The tool list was refreshed ({count} tools) — restart the mureo MCP server to pick them up.
en.dashboard.amazon_exchange_done_manifest_: Authorized, but the tool list could not be refreshed. Use “Refresh tool list” above to try again.
en.dashboard.amazon_exchange_code_expired: Amazon rejected that code. Codes are single-use and expire 5 minutes after consent — authorize again and paste the new address right away.
en.dashboard.amazon_exchange_code_required: Paste the full address Amazon redirected you to (it contains code=…), or the code itself.
en.dashboard.amazon_exchange_no_credentials: Save the Client ID and Client Secret in this card first, then authorize.
en.dashboard.amazon_exchange_invalid_redire: The return URL must start with https:// and be listed in your Login with Amazon security profile.
en.dashboard.amazon_exchange_failed: Authorization failed. Check the saved Client ID, Client Secret and region, then authorize again.
en.dashboard.amazon_refresh_token_expiring: This Amazon authorization is {days} days old. Amazon expires refresh tokens a year after consent — authorize again to avoid an interruption.
en.dashboard.plugin_credentials_secret_plac: (unchanged — leave blank to keep current value)
en.dashboard.plugin_oauth_save_client_first: Save the client ID and secret first, then authenticate.
en.dashboard.plugin_oauth_callback_hint: Register this exact URL as the redirect/callback URI in the provider's developer console, then click Authenticate.
en.dashboard.plugin_oauth_target_unset: Not set — click Authenticate to obtain it.
en.dashboard.plugin_accounts_empty: No accounts found for this connection.
en.dashboard.plugin_oauth_callback_invalid: The callback URL must be a loopback URL like http://127.0.0.1:8765/oauth/callback (http, 127.0.0.1 or localhost, with a port and path).
en.dashboard.plugin_oauth_port_unavailable: That callback port is already in use. Close whatever is using it, or register a different port, then retry.
en.dashboard.confirm_remove_mcp: Remove mureo MCP from Claude config?
en.dashboard.clear_all_desc: Deletes all mureo configuration (MCP entry, auth hook, skills, installed official providers, legacy commands). Credentials in ~/.mureo/credentials.json are not touched.
en.dashboard.confirm_clear_all_1: Clear ALL mureo setup? This will remove MCP entries, hooks, skills, and installed providers.
en.dashboard.confirm_clear_all_2: OAuth tokens and env vars in ~/.mureo/credentials.json will NOT be touched. Continue?
en.dashboard.skills_stale_note: Installed skills are from mureo {installed} — this package is {expected}. Re-install to update them.
en.dashboard.skills_stale_note_unknown: Installed skills do not record which mureo they came from — this package is {expected}. Re-install to update them.
en.dashboard.install_already: Already up to date — nothing to change.
en.dashboard.tooluse_err_connector_not_conn: Connect the Meta connector first (see the steps above).
en.dashboard.tooluse_err_generic: Could not switch. Please try again.
en.dashboard.provider_hosted_oauth_note: Registered as a hosted MCP. Finish in Claude Code: run /mcp → Authenticate (Meta login), then reconnect. Meta has no OAuth dynamic client registration — if /mcp reports that, re-register with `claude mcp add --transport http --client-id … --client-secret --callback-port …`, or use the account-level claude.ai Meta Ads connector.
en.dashboard.provider_desktop_connectors_no: Can't be added from here. In Claude Desktop, open Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector, enter the URL https://mcp.facebook.com/ads, then sign in with Meta.
en.dashboard.provider_codex_hosted_na_note: Meta's official hosted MCP isn't available on Codex (no account-level connector). Keep using mureo's built-in Meta tools instead.
en.dashboard.provider_tiktok_oauth_note: Register it as a remote MCP: run `claude mcp add --transport http tiktok-ads https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_mcp/tt-ads-mcp-layer`, then in Claude Code run /mcp → Authenticate and sign in with your TikTok for Business account. TikTok supports OAuth dynamic client registration, so a claude.ai connector isn't required (you can still add one with the same URL if you prefer).
en.dashboard.provider_tiktok_desktop_note: In Claude Desktop, open Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector, enter the URL https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_mcp/tt-ads-mcp-layer, then sign in with your TikTok for Business account.
en.dashboard.provider_tiktok_codex_note: TikTok's official hosted MCP isn't wired for Codex here yet. Use Claude Code (the `claude mcp add` command above) or Claude Desktop to add it.
en.connector.setup_title: Add Meta Ads in Claude Desktop
en.connector.setup_lead: Meta's hosted MCP can't be configured from here (it has no OAuth dynamic client registration). Add it once in Claude Desktop:
en.connector.step4: Sign in with your Meta Business account when prompted
en.connector.code.setup_title: Add Meta Ads via a Claude.ai connector
en.connector.code.setup_lead: Meta's hosted MCP can't be OAuth-authenticated as a Claude Code user-scope server (it has no dynamic client registration), so mureo does not register it locally. On Claude Code, add it as a Claude.ai account connector instead — Anthropic brokers the sign-in there, and it then works account-wide.
en.connector.code.step1: Open claude.ai → Settings → Connectors (claude.ai/customize/connectors). Requires a paid plan — Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise; the Free plan cannot add connectors.
en.connector.code.step4: Click Add and complete the Meta Business sign-in in the browser. Then, back in Claude Code, run /mcp to verify — Meta tools load as mcp__claude_ai_MetaAds__* (free during Meta’s beta). mureo-native Meta stays active until you switch it off with “mureo providers confirm”.
en.connector.finalize_ok: Connected ✓ — mureo's native Meta tools are now disabled so Claude uses the official connector. Restart Claude to apply.
en.connector.finalize_already: Already finalized — mureo's native Meta tools are disabled; nothing to do.
en.connector.finalize_not_connected: Not connected yet. Finish the browser steps above (sign in with Meta), then click this again.
en.connector.finalize_manual: On Claude Desktop mureo can't auto-detect the account connector. If Settings → Connectors shows Meta Ads = Connected, you're all set — click “I've verified it” to switch Claude to the official connector. Until you do, mureo-native Meta stays on (nothing is stranded).
en.connector.finalize_unverifiable: Couldn't auto-verify (the Claude Code CLI isn't available here, or the check timed out). This does NOT mean your Meta login failed. If Meta shows Connected in Claude, click “I've verified it” to switch over; otherwise mureo-native Meta stays on.
en.connector.finalize_affirm: I've verified it — switch to the official connector
en.connector.finalize_failed: Couldn't finalize. Make sure the connector is set up, then try again.
en.wizard.completed.pending_meta: One step left for Meta Ads — it can only be wired via a Claude.ai connector (Meta’s hosted MCP has no OAuth dynamic client registration, so mureo can’t register it locally). Open claude.ai → Settings → Connectors, Add custom connector with URL https://mcp.facebook.com/ads, finish the Meta sign-in, then verify with /mcp in Claude Code. Requires a paid plan (Free can’t add connectors).
en.wizard.completed.pending_tiktok: One step left for TikTok Ads — its hosted MCP needs a browser sign-in. On Claude Code, run `claude mcp add --transport http tiktok-ads https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_mcp/tt-ads-mcp-layer`, then /mcp → Authenticate and sign in with your TikTok for Business account. No claude.ai connector is required — TikTok supports OAuth dynamic client registration.
en.wizard.completed.pending_amazon: One step left for Amazon Ads — its tools are served from a locally generated manifest. Open the dashboard’s Amazon Ads card and click “Refresh tool list” (or run `mureo amazon refresh-manifest`), then restart the mureo MCP server so Claude picks the tools up.

ja.connector.setup_title: Claude Desktop で Meta Ads を追加
ja.connector.setup_lead: この hosted MCP はここからは設定できません（Meta は OAuth の動的クライアント登録に非対応）。Claude Desktop で一度だけ追加してください:
ja.connector.step1: Claude Desktop → 設定 → コネクタ を開く
ja.connector.step2: 「カスタムコネクタを追加」をクリック
ja.connector.step3: この URL を貼り付けて保存:
ja.connector.step4: 表示されたら Meta ビジネスアカウントでログイン
ja.connector.code.setup_title: claude.ai コネクタ経由で Meta Ads を追加
ja.connector.code.setup_lead: Meta の hosted MCP は Claude Code のユーザースコープサーバとしては OAuth 認証できません（動的クライアント登録に非対応）。このため mureo はローカル登録しません。Claude Code では claude.ai アカウントコネクタとして追加してください — 認証は Anthropic 側で仲介され、追加後はアカウント全体で有効になります。
ja.connector.code.step1: claude.ai → Settings → Connectors（claude.ai/customize/connectors）を開く。有料プラン必須 — Pro / Max / Team / Enterprise。Free プランはコネクタを追加できません。
ja.connector.code.step3: この MCP サーバ URL を貼り付け:
ja.connector.code.step4: Add をクリックし、ブラウザで Meta ビジネスアカウントのサインインを完了。その後 Claude Code に戻り /mcp で確認 — Meta ツールが mcp__claude_ai_MetaAds__* としてロードされます（Meta のベータ期間中は無料）。mureo-native Meta は「mureo providers confirm」で切り替えるまで有効のままです。
ja.connector.finalize: 接続できたので確定する
ja.connector.finalize_ok: 接続を確認 ✓ — mureo ネイティブ Meta ツールを無効化しました。Claude は公式コネクタを使用します。反映には Claude の再起動が必要です。
ja.connector.finalize_already: 確定済み — mureo ネイティブ Meta ツールは無効化されています。操作は不要です。
ja.connector.finalize_not_connected: まだ接続されていません。上のブラウザ手順（Meta でログイン）を完了してから、もう一度クリックしてください。
ja.connector.finalize_manual: Claude Desktop ではアカウントコネクタを自動検出できません。設定 → コネクタ で Meta Ads が Connected になっていれば準備完了です — 「確認しました」を押すと公式コネクタに切り替えます。押すまで mureo ネイティブ Meta は有効のまま（取り残しはありません）。
ja.connector.finalize_unverifiable: 自動検証できませんでした（このマシンに Claude Code CLI が無い、または確認がタイムアウト）。Meta ログインが失敗したという意味ではありません。Claude 上で Meta が Connected なら「確認しました」を押して切り替えてください。そうでなければ mureo ネイティブ Meta は有効のままです。
ja.connector.finalize_affirm: 確認しました — 公式コネクタに切り替える
ja.connector.finalize_failed: 確定できませんでした。コネクタの設定を確認して再度お試しください。
ja.wizard.completed.pending_meta: Meta Ads はあと1ステップ — claude.ai コネクタ経由でのみ連携できます（Meta の hosted MCP は OAuth 動的クライアント登録に非対応で、mureo はローカル登録できません）。claude.ai → Settings → Connectors を開き、URL https://mcp.facebook.com/ads でカスタムコネクタを追加し、Meta のサインインを完了 → Claude Code の /mcp で確認。有料プランが必要です（Free はコネクタ追加不可）。
ja.wizard.completed.pending_tiktok: TikTok Ads はあと1ステップ — hosted MCP のブラウザサインインが必要です。Claude Code では `claude mcp add --transport http tiktok-ads https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_mcp/tt-ads-mcp-layer` を実行し、/mcp → Authenticate から TikTok for Business アカウントでサインインしてください。TikTok は OAuth 動的クライアント登録に対応しているため、claude.ai コネクタは不要です。
ja.wizard.completed.pending_amazon: Amazon 広告はあと1ステップ — ツールはローカルに生成したマニフェストから提供されます。ダッシュボードの Amazon 広告カードで「ツール一覧を更新」をクリック（または `mureo amazon refresh-manifest` を実行）し、mureo MCP サーバーを再起動してください。
